1.sahih_international: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
1.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant?
1.yusuf_ali: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the Companions of the Elephant?
1.shakir: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with the possessors of the elephant?
1.muhammad_sarwar: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with the people of the elephant?
1.mohsin_khan: Have you (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) not seen how your Lord dealt with the Owners of the Elephant? [The elephant army which came from Yemen under the command of Abrahah Al-Ashram intending to destroy the Ka'bah at Makkah].
1.arberry: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord did with the Men of the Elephant?

2.sahih_international: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
2.pickthall: Did He not bring their stratagem to naught,
2.yusuf_ali: Did He not make their treacherous plan go astray?
2.shakir: Did He not cause their war to end in confusion,
2.muhammad_sarwar: Did He not cause their evil plots to fail
2.mohsin_khan: Did He not make their plot go astray?
2.arberry: Did He not make their guile to go astray?

3.sahih_international: And He sent against them birds in flocks,
3.pickthall: And send against them swarms of flying creatures,
3.yusuf_ali: And He sent against them Flights of Birds,
3.shakir: And send down (to prey) upon them birds in flocks,
3.muhammad_sarwar: by sending against them flocks of swallows
3.mohsin_khan: And sent against them birds, in flocks,
3.arberry: And He loosed upon them birds in flights,

4.sahih_international: Striking them with stones of hard clay,
4.pickthall: Which pelted them with stones of baked clay,
4.yusuf_ali: Striking them with stones of baked clay.
4.shakir: Casting against them stones of baked clay,
4.muhammad_sarwar: which showered them with small pebbles of clay
4.mohsin_khan: Striking them with stones of Sijjil.
4.arberry: hurling against them stones of baked clay

5.sahih_international: And He made them like eaten straw.
5.pickthall: And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle)?
5.yusuf_ali: Then did He make them like an empty field of stalks and straw, (of which the corn) has been eaten up.
5.shakir: So He rendered them like straw eaten up?
5.muhammad_sarwar: to turn them into (something) like the left-over grass grazed by cattle.
5.mohsin_khan: And made them like an empty field of stalks (of which the corn has been eaten up by cattle).
5.arberry: and He made them like green blades devoured.
